status.en: 8 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 20% fewer than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Baidoa and Puntland.
status.nb: 8 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 20 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Baidoa og Puntland.

summary.en: Al-Shabaab militants attacked near the Kenya-Somalia border, killing eight people, and later announced they assassinated a Somali intelligence officer in Mogadishu after a ten-year pursuit. Somali security forces opened fire on protesters in Mogadishu, killing three civilians. The Somali National Army killed senior Al-Shabaab commanders in an operation in Lower Shabelle. Somalia condemned the Mandera attack that killed eight Kenyan citizens. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Al-Shabaab-militante angrep nær Kenya-Somalia-grensen, og drepte åtte personer, og kunngjorde senere at de hadde likvidert en somalisk etterretningsoffiser i Mogadishu etter et tiårig forfølgelsesløp. Somalisk sikkerhetsstyrke skjøt på demonstranter i Mogadishu, og drepte tre sivile. Den somaliske nasjonalarmeen drepte høytstående Al-Shabaab-kommandoer i en operasjon i Lower Shabelle. Somalia fordømte Mandera-angrepet som drepte åtte kenyanske borgere. Konflikten førte til 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
